data.one_liner: A widget that provides Instagram-like pinch-to-zoom that resets size when released.
data.what_it_does: It wraps any widget or image in an interactive viewer enabling pinch-to-zoom over the screen. Once the interaction ends, it smoothly animates the widget back to its original size.
use_when: You want Instagram-like photo zoom behavior in your Flutter app.
You need a pinch-to-zoom experience that automatically resets after release.
avoid_when: You need persistent zooming where the widget stays zoomed in after the user lets go.
You require complex map or pan-and-scan functionalities that do not reset.
strengths: Provides a smooth return-to-original-size animation upon release.
Supports custom parameters like minScale, maxScale, overlay colors, and touch gesture restrictions.
weaknesses: Requires manual gesture coordination when nested inside scrollable widgets.
Not documented for standalone persistent zoom requirements.
